claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: Existing safeguards provide a framework for protecting students while allowing educators and local leaders the flexibility to determine how technology can best support learning. The FCC should continue to support access to educational connectivity without expanding its role into decisions about classroom instruction and local educational practices.
claims.evidence_quote: Local educators are best positioned to make these decisions based on the needs of their students. Schools and libraries receiving E-Rate funding already have established responsibilities related to internet safety, including compliance with the Children's Internet Protection Act (CIPA). Existing safeguards provide a framework for protecting students while allowing educators and local leaders the flexibility to determine how technology can best support learning. The FCC should continue to support access to educational connectivity without expanding its role into decisions about classroom instruction and local educational practices.
